mapper.select: SELECT cm.id, cm.room_id as roomId, cm.sender_id as userId, cm.message as content, cm.message_type as messageType, NOW() as createdAt, NOW() as updatedAt, CASE WHEN sp.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', sp.student_id) WHEN pp.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', pp.professor_id) WHEN stp.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', stp.staff_id) WHEN ap.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', ap.assistant_id) ELSE u.name END as senderName FROM chat_messages cm LEFT JOIN users u ON cm.sender_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON u.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN professor_profiles pp ON u.id = pp.user_id LEFT JOIN staff_profiles stp ON u.id = stp.user_id LEFT JOIN assistant_profiles ap ON u.id = ap.user_id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages ( room_id, sender_id, message, message_type ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{messageType,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id as roomId, sender_id as userId, message as content, message_type as messageType, NOW() as createdAt, NOW() as updatedAt FROM chat_messages WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, room_id as roomId, sender_id as userId, message as content, message_type as messageType, NOW() as createdAt, NOW() as updatedAt FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, room_id as roomId, sender_id as userId, message as content, message_type as messageType, NOW() as createdAt, NOW() as updatedAt FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cm.id, cm.room_id as roomId, cm.sender_id as userId, cm.message as content, cm.message_type as messageType, NOW() as createdAt, NOW() as updatedAt, CASE WHEN sp.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', sp.student_id) WHEN pp.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', pp.professor_id) WHEN stp.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', stp.staff_id) WHEN ap.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(u.name, '/', ap.assistant_id) ELSE u.name END as senderName FROM chat_messages cm LEFT JOIN users u ON cm.sender_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON u.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN professor_profiles pp ON u.id = pp.user_id LEFT JOIN staff_profiles stp ON u.id = stp.user_id LEFT JOIN assistant_profiles ap ON u.id = ap.user_id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} AND cm.message LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') ORDER BY cm.id DESC
